vpn_name.description: Name of the VPN network (used in paths and host identification)

debug_level.description: Debug verbosity level (0 = none, 1 = normal, 2 = verbose)

interface_type.description: Network interface type: 'tun' for IP routing, 'tap' for Ethernet bridging

local_address.description: Local IP address to bind to (leave blank to auto-detect)

port.description: TCP/UDP port used by tinc for incoming connections

cipher.description: Symmetric encryption algorithm for data traffic

hash.description: Hash algorithm used for integrity checks

max_connections.description: Maximum number of simultaneous peer connections allowed

keepalive_interval.description: Seconds between keepalive pings to maintain connection health

timeout.description: Seconds of inactivity before declaring a peer unreachable

ipv6.description: Enable IPv6 support on the VPN interface

subnets.description: List of subnets this node will route on the mesh

static_hosts.description: List of pre-defined host entries for static peers
